mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. This signal is active whenever the rate is at or below the threshold, without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.5% indicates economic weakness that triggers risk-off sentiment, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%, or the Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent expansion in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when both RSAFS and HOUST show positive growth, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.04 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals overcapacity and impending slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 40% of late-cycle expansion periods, or the Rank IC for INDPRO in this regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of months with PAYEMS growth, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.04.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 1000 thousand units signal strong residential construction activity, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of months when HOUST exceeds 1000, or the Rank IC over 2-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) and rising inflation (CPIAUCSL growth > 0.2% monthly) indicates an impending monetary tightening cycle, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5 and CPIAUCSL growth > 0.2, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong GDP growth (annualized rate > 2%), corporate earnings growth is sustained, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of strong GDP growth periods, or the Rank IC for GDPC1 in this regime is below 0.04.
